additional_info.subject: ID0483673-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / S2 170003320] Charging Issue CRM:03288000511
additional_info.body:
Dear Jonas,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, and after checking the charger, we see that the charger is not connected to the SCB connection.
This means we are not able to see any updates regarding the charger, or any logs.
We would like to ask you to turn the SCB connection on, by checking the internet cable of the charger.
If you are not able to turn the SCB online again, please let us know, and we will forward this request to the technical team.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
